factual_sources.text:
Company Overview

Northstar Analytics builds analytics and workflow automation software for operations teams in finance, healthcare operations, logistics, and professional services. Employees are expected to protect customer trust, communicate clearly, and make decisions that improve operational reliability.

Northstar has offices in Toronto, Montreal, and New York. The company supports hybrid work and approved remote work across Canada and the United States.

Wellness Stipend

Eligible full-time employees receive a wellness stipend of 750 CAD or 550 USD per calendar year, based on payroll country. The stipend may be used for fitness memberships, mental health apps, ergonomic equipment, or wellness programs.

Unused wellness stipend amounts do not carry over into the next calendar year.

Cross-Border Work

Northstar does not guarantee approval for work from any country. Temporary cross-border work requires People Operations review before travel. The company does not maintain a formal visa or immigration policy in the employee knowledge base.

Requests to work outside Canada or the United States are considered ambiguous until People Operations reviews tax, employment, and security implications.

Work Model

Northstar supports hybrid work and approved remote work. Employees assigned to Toronto, Montreal, or New York offices are expected to attend office collaboration days when scheduled by their department.

Remote employees may work from approved locations in Canada or the United States if their role, tax location, and security requirements support remote work.

Ideal Customer Profile

Northstar is best suited for operations teams with complex approvals, recurring data quality issues, and reporting delays across multiple departments. Strong-fit customers often have 500 to 5,000 employees and existing workflow tools that lack executive reporting.

Priority industries are finance operations, healthcare operations, logistics, and professional services.
